personality_one_liner: A cinematic, high-contrast, premium photography studio prioritizing visual-first storytelling with deep black canvases and electric purple/blue accents.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for cinematic feel; avoid cramped dashboard styles.

do's: Apply to sticky headers, bottom tab bar, and overlay cards.
Always layer a >=75% opacity tint under the blur for dark mode readability.
Use over rich background photography to create depth.
dont's: Do not apply glass to body text containers or form fields.
Avoid stacking more than 2 glass surfaces.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A visual-first storytelling dashboard showcasing services, pose categories, and recent studio projects.

states.loading: Subtle skeleton loaders over dark canvas
states.empty: No recent projects? Display a cinematic hero card prompting to 'Start a Shoot'
states.error: Centered minimalist error text with a 'Retry' text button

screens.layout: Hero image with gradient scrim at top, followed by 2-column image-led grids for Pose Categories (Solo, Couple, Fashion). Horizontal scroll for My Projects at the bottom. Sticky glass header over scroll.

screens.name: Camera
screens.purpose: Minimalist, immersive live AI viewfinder focusing entirely on the shot and real-time guidance.

states.error: Camera permission denied layout with deep black background and a primary CTA

screens.layout: Full-bleed camera view. Floating controls (flash, timer, grid) at top. High-contrast, color-coded alignment skeleton overlays. Bottom sheet trigger for pose match score. Minimal UI chrome to prevent distraction.

screens.name: PoseAI
screens.purpose: A filterable, image-led library of poses providing structural reference and instructions.

states.loading: Grid of blank cards with loading shimmer
states.empty: No poses found for the filter - minimalist illustration with reset CTA
states.error: Failed to load poses, tap to retry

screens.layout: Sticky glass category chip row (Solo, Couple, Wedding). 2-column masonry or grid layout of pose photos. Detail view opens in a full-screen modal with stick-figure overlay and camera angle instructions.

screens.name: ABYA
screens.purpose: Multilingual AI assistant chat optimized for conversational history and content generation.

states.empty: Welcome screen with prompt suggestions and a large voice mic button

screens.layout: Chat interface using `surfaceSecondary` for user bubbles and `brandTertiary` for AI. Large glassmorphic floating Voice Input button pinned at bottom.

screens.name: CreativeStudio
screens.purpose: Professional, multi-purpose photo editor and collage maker focusing on large previews and precise controls.

states.empty: Select an image to start editing

screens.layout: Large image preview area taking up top 60%. Bottom 40% houses a horizontal scrollable tool navigation (Crop, Sliders, Filters, AI Enhance). Selected tools replace the bottom area with fine-grained sliders.

category_couple.alt: woman in white sweater wearing black framed eyeglasses

category_fashion.alt: A man in a green outfit stands outdoors

studio_empty_state.alt: grayscale photography of man wearing dress shirt

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Glass / Luxe DARK personality. Deep black (#050505) is the root surface, using electric purple (#651FFF) and blue (#2979FF) ONLY for premium accents, active states, and CTAs per the user's explicit override request.
Implement a 5-tab bottom navigation (Home, Camera, Pose AI, ABYA, My Projects) with a heavily tinted blur background to sit smoothly over dark scrolling content.
In the Camera and Creative Studio screens, maximize the viewable canvas. Use translucent floating overlays for controls (like the grid/flash buttons) to prevent obscuring the photography.
For all images loaded in cards (Pose categories, My Projects), you MUST apply a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to #050505) over the bottom 30-40% so overlay text is readable.
The Live AI camera should utilize high-contrast color-coded tracking lines (defaulting to white/gray, shifting to the `success` token #00E676 for correct pose alignment).

Based on UI research: Structure the Creative Studio/Photo editor with a large preview at the top, and bottom-sheet style toolbars for specific fine-grained sliders (contrast, blur, vignette). Avoid cluttering the screen with all tools at once.
